historical_basis.global_extraction_start_precision: day_only; no defensible shared second-level timestamp

time_fields.publication: source-evidenced publication day or source timestamp; used for scope and month
time_fields.retrieval_or_extraction: when current source bytes or metadata were acquired; not a publication fallback
time_fields.content_version_or_modification: version evidence; not a publication fallback
time_fields.report_or_snapshot: when counts were produced; not a publication fallback

partial_precision_rule: retain candidates and their evidence; include only if the entire possible date interval is within the fixed scope; otherwise mark uncertain for date review
out_of_range_rule: preserve raw and metadata in an exception ledger; exclude only from in-window derived counts pending review; do not delete or silently change dates
GOVUK_timezone_issue: 119 stored local publication dates differ by one day from UTC-normalized publication_timestamp; 3 cross month boundaries. Review source date semantics before changing stored dates or monthly bins.
source_specific_observation: A date-filter upper bound does not imply the first GOV.UK Search index was observed through the end of 2026-09-21; retain per-source observed times.
backfill: Later retrieval may add source-evidenced publication dates in this same interval, with retrieval and version times separately recorded; it never changes the study endpoint or proves historical body wording.
endpoint_change: requires Dai's explicit decision and a new corpus version
